headline: Free Claude Code adds browser harness sessions
lede: The project claims native browser sessions across multiple coding harnesses and models, with voice support.

effects.effect: Brings multiple harnesses behind a shared access layer

appearances.title: Alishahryar1/free-claude-code
appearances.summary: Use Claude Code, Codex, VSCode, Pi, and OpenCode (and 6 other harnesses) for free (1.3B+ free tokens) from your terminal, app, IDE, or phone, and now from the browser with native browser sessions (multi-harness + multi-model) like OpenClaw (voice supported + ToS friendly)
